# polaris_catalog (Resource)

Manages an Apache Polaris catalog with storage configuration (S3, GCS, Azure, File).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_catalog" "analytics" {
  name                  = "analytics_catalog"
  default_base_location = "s3://lakehouse-bucket/analytics"

  storage_config {
    storage_type      = "S3"
    allowed_locations = ["s3://lakehouse-bucket/analytics"]
    role_arn          = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/polaris-lakehouse-role"
    region            = "us-east-1"
  }

  properties = {
    team        = "analytics"
    environment = "production"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_base_location` (String) Default base storage location for tables in this catalog (e.g. `s3://bucket/path`, `gs://bucket/path`, `abfss://container@account.blob.core.windows.net/path`).
- `name` (String) The unique name of the catalog.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata properties for the catalog.
- `storage_config` (Block, Optional) Storage configuration for cloud credential vending and location access validation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--storage_config))
- `type` (String) Catalog type. Supported values: `INTERNAL` (default) or `EXTERNAL`.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter for optimistic concurrency.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

<a id="nestedblock--storage_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_config`

Required:

- `storage_type` (String) Storage provider type: `S3`, `GCS`, `AZURE`, or `FILE`.

Optional:

- `allowed_locations` (List of String) List of storage locations allowed for tables created in this catalog.
- `consent_url` (String) URL for Azure permissions request consent.
- `endpoint` (String) Custom S3 endpoint URL (for S3-compatible object stores such as MinIO or Ceph).
- `external_id` (String) Optional AWS external ID used to assume the IAM role.
- `gcs_service_account` (String) Google Cloud Storage service account email used for authentication.
- `hierarchical` (Boolean) If true, scopes SAS tokens for hierarchical namespace (ADLS Gen2).
- `kms_unavailable` (Boolean) If true, instructs Polaris to avoid adding KMS key policies.
- `multi_tenant_app_name` (String) Azure client application name.
- `path_style_access` (Boolean) Whether to use path-style addressing for S3 buckets.
- `region` (String) AWS Region where the S3 bucket is hosted.
- `role_arn` (String) AWS IAM Role ARN assumed by Polaris to vend credentials for S3.
- `storage_name` (String) Optional name referencing a server-side storage configuration.
- `sts_endpoint` (String) Custom AWS STS endpoint URL.
- `sts_unavailable` (Boolean) If true, avoids using STS endpoints when vending storage credentials (for non-STS S3 compatible stores).
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure Tenant ID where the storage account belongs.
- `user_arn` (String) AWS IAM User ARN used to assume the role.
